searchText: Hey everyone 👋 I know that EIPs are no longer the place for JSON-RPC methods But I would really like to propose the addition of eth_signMessage In order to avoid the troubled history of eth_sign vs personal_sign https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-3361-eth-signmessage/5969 I think the best approach is to create a PR against the json-rpc spec (https://github.com/ethereum/eth1.0-specs/tree/master/json-rpc) and convince core devs to accept probably via ACD I’m guessing that removing eth_sign would be going to far right?😅 Perhaps just adding the same with different name Actually I just noticed that is not even there hmm, that's unfortunate we may need to separate the spec into "this is the minimal json-rpc" and "this is the wallet-compatible json-rpc"
